acip: GONG DU 'DOD NA, GSER BUM CHOS CAN, BUM PA DANG GCIG TU GYUR PA'I BUM PA MA YIN PAR THAL, BUM PA DANG GCIG MA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
english: And suppose you change your position, and instead agree to our point above; that is, suppose you say: “A porcelain coffee cup is a coffee cup which is one and the same as a coffee cup.” In that case, let's again consider a porcelain coffee cup.  No, it's not a coffee cup which is one and the same as a coffee cup! Why do you say that? Because it's not one and the same as a coffee cup!
